findings: The same seven dispute categories and their evidence packet guidance remain substantively unchanged across old raw lines 14–270 and new raw lines 15–271: credit not processed, duplicate, fraudulent, general, product not received, product unacceptable, and subscription canceled. In both captures the images are illustrative, not evidence of an actual customer, transaction, refund, issuer decision, or guaranteed dispute outcome.

The November raw changes image references from prior local assets/stripe-disputes-evidence-*.png paths to Stripe CDN URLs and adds See also links (new 273–277). The diff otherwise reflects emphasis and heading whitespace. Do not claim visual pixel equivalence or that the remote URLs were downloaded; the old local asset provenance belongs to the older capture.

Current source lines 13 and 55 and wiki/concepts/disputes.md line 92 say 62 illustrative images. Both raw pages contain 66 image embeds with 64 distinct image paths; the local raw/assets/stripe-disputes-evidence-* file set contains 64 files. The exact 62 claim is therefore unsupported by the retained Markdown and asset inventory and should be corrected or removed, with 66 references versus 64 distinct paths stated only if a count is needed.

Source line 13 also describes examples for both approved and denied scenarios across seven categories, but explicit Approved/Denied subsections occur only under Credit not processed and Duplicate (old 18–67; new 19–68). Other categories offer counter-evidence guidance without that paired structure; qualify the description rather than imply every category has both example types.
substantive_changes: No changed packet guidance was found. A narrow source/concept correction is required for the pre-existing 62-image count, and source wording should scope approved/denied pairings to the two categories that have them. Add the new raw as a separate dated reference while preserving local asset provenance for the older capture.
historical_claims_to_preserve: The old raw references saved local image assets; the new raw references remote Stripe CDN images. Preserve the prior raw and its assets as historical evidence and do not imply the new remote images were captured locally.

The seven-category breakdown and category-specific evidence suggestions remain intact; these are illustrative examples and non-exhaustive best practices, not required checklists or guarantees of a favorable issuer decision.
Credit not processed and Duplicate have explicit Approved and Denied packet examples; preserve that narrower distinction.
conflicts: The source's 62 image claim (lines 13, 55) and concept's matching claim (wiki/concepts/disputes.md:92) disagree with 66 image references and 64 unique image paths in each raw capture and 64 local matching asset files.
The source's 'both approved and denied scenarios' phrasing at line 13 is overly broad for all seven categories: only the first two categories have those paired subsections.
unresolved_questions: The raw Markdown and diff establish changed image URL references but do not establish whether corresponding local and remote image bytes or visual content are identical.

answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/disputes/visual-evidence, the old and new captures preserve the same seven category-specific packet suggestions, including refund documentation (old line 23; new line 24), digital access logs (old line 163; new line 164), and renewal reminders (old line 260; new line 261). [[source-stripe-disputes-visual-evidence]] needs a narrow count and scope correction: both captures have 66 image embeds and 64 distinct paths, while it says 62 and implies all seven categories have Approved/Denied pairings.
answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/disputes/visual-evidence, retain [[source-stripe-disputes-visual-evidence]] as the route to illustrative, non-exhaustive examples: old raw line 12 and new raw line 13 expressly say images are illustrative. The November capture replaces local image links with remote Stripe CDN links and adds navigation at new lines 273–277; it does not prove identical image bytes or a new evidence requirement. Correct the source and linked disputes concept's 62-image claim, preserve historical local assets, and scope approved/denied pairings to the first two categories.
